author: cc68-tea
method: New locale-specific complete sentence banks; seeded sampling without replacement of sentence-index tuples; no screening or term-list input
deduplication: Exact and NFKC casefold; disjoint from in-sample clean, v1 and v2; field lengths enforced before one-time import
repairInspection: No new builder repair inspected during v3 authoring
priorKnowledge: Reviewer retains prior v2 results and the previously released repair. New text comes from a fresh neutral prompt and is never selected using screening outputs.
